info.name: IaM Accounts API
info.description: These APIs facilitate the management of customer accounts and their relationships. They support creating accounts, retrieving account hierarchies, and managing platform-specific mappings for parent and associated child accounts. Designed for flexibility and scalability, these APIs ensure efficient handling of account-related data and relationships.

query.description: The account ID is a unique identifier of your account, which begins with acct_. This optional filter parameter lets you get platforms mapped to a specific account.

request.description: This endpoint retrieves the platform mappings for an account and its child accounts.
